## Arguments
- Maul vs Obi-Wan (t465): Kenobi majority: MasterCilghal "Kenobi, high difficulty"; CuckedCurry "Kenobi decimates"; NevesYtneves "Kenobi already did a 2V1 against Maul and Savage during TCW [CANON]. He should be capable of winning solo at peak"; SithSauce "Kenobi barely wins"; Praxis "Maul will forever and always be Kenobi's bitch." Minority: MP "I could see Maul taking this"; Syndiciate either way. On-screen record: TPM Obi-Wan kills Maul (Legends + Canon film; Legends novelization same); TCW/Rebels [CANON] Kenobi beats him again on Tatooine (Rebels "Twin Suns").
- Maul vs Vader (t158): Vader majority, mostly "good fight": SithSauce "Vader wins in the fight of his life"; NevesYtneves "Vader slaps him after a good fight"; HeartoftheForce "Vader. Excellent fight"; xolthol "mid-difficulty"; BreakofDawn "Vader in a good fight. More powerful, physically stronger and comparable technique that kept improving"; CuckedCurry/Marc Spector/HellfireUnit stomps. Pro-Maul: MP ("Maul mastered every lightsaber form, Anakin never did"), Nova (Lucas / Fightsaber / Lightsabers: A Guide to the Weapons: Vader's suit limits mobility; "in a raw lightsaber fight, I think Maul would take it"). dark-sith123: Shadow Conspiracy (Legends novel; NOTE it is actually a Legends young-reader novel) "states that Maul grew more powerful from The Phantom Menace to the Clone Wars" (text not quoted). The Legends comic Star Wars Tales "Resurrection" (Vader vs a cloned Maul) is non-canon Infinities-type ("That was not Maul, an amped doppelganger", HellfireUnit in t1100).
- Maul vs Dooku (t1209) [CANON]: Dooku majority. Jeremy Barlow (SoD writer) quote via BreakofDawn: "His power isn't on Vader's level, true, or even on Count Dooku's level — but that never stops him. He stands alongside the Sith Lords only by sheer force o[f will]" ; Barlow tweet via HeartoftheForce: "6/10 sounds good. Maybe even 7/10—'cause Maul won't quit until he's completely out." (Twitter.com/Jeremy_Barlow/status/[id]; AUTHOR, Canon comic). DoA: "Erkan bugged the hell out of Barlow until he said what he wanted". Deronn_Solo "Dooku 7/10".
- Author/OOU Legends: Lucas on TPM-era duel choreography vs the OT (cited as "Vader is a pale shadow" of PT duelists; SithSauce calls it hyperbole about choreography).

## My takeaways
1. Maul vs Obi-Wan: in Legends, TPM Obi-Wan beats TPM Maul (film); ROTS Obi-Wan is far beyond Padawan Obi-Wan. Maul loses to ROTS Kenobi (Legends) at mid diff.
2. Maul vs Vader: Vader (suit prime) wins, mid-high diff; Maul's saber skill is his only edge.
3. Consistent with Dooku > Maul (6.5/10) from 2026-10-17. Gaps: no Legends-only Maul thread on SI (Shadow Hunter, Saboteur); the i_like_swords "Darth Maul - TPM" and "The Power of Darth Maul" RTs still unread.
